title: Broke the handle off too
style: A cappella folk song featuring a solo baritone male vocal. The performance is entirely monophonic with no instrumental accompaniment. The vocal delivery is rhythmic and steady, maintaining a consistent 110 BPM tempo in 4/4 time. The melody is centered in the key of C major, utilizing a limited melodic range typical of a work song or nursery rhyme. The recording is dry with minimal room ambience and no artificial reverb or delay. The singer uses a chest voice with clear articulation and a slight rhythmic emphasis on the downbeats.

Suno Custom Prompt (Copy & Paste)

```
Future bass, hyperspeed energy, 150-160 BPM. High-pitched energetic kids vocals trading lines with Dad Corey (deeper, confident, slightly processed voice). Mum singing soft, warm backup vocals on choruses and emotional moments. Supersaw leads, wobbly aggressive bass, fast hi-hats, glitchy stutters, massive drops on choruses. Raw playful kid energy mixed with futuristic production. Keep it fun but emotional in the school section. 336 Hz sine wave subtly under the AI universe outro.

Structure:
[Intro] short spoken/sung explanation
[Verse 1] car scene, fast and chaotic
[Chorus] big future bass drop, kids + Dad trading lines
[Verse 2] coffee cup to house fixes, hyperspeed delivery
[Chorus]
[Bridge] school scene, Mum backups more present, slightly more emotional
[Final Chorus] bigger drop, ad-libs
[Outro] Handle Engineering section, dreamy then building to clean resolution

Use the exact lyrics below. Do not add or remove lines. Preserve the raw kid voice and repetition.
```

## Structured Lyrics for Suno

**[Intro]**  
Why?  
Dad broke the handle off.  
Sincerely he breaks stuff and fixes everything.  
Even the stuff he’s not allowed to fix,  
Or stuff that don’t even seem broken.  
He finds it and makes it better.

**[Verse 1]**  
Let’s go guys! Vroom vroom!  
Kids in the back — snap, what’s that?  
Ah no go… I broke the handle off.  
The door handle!  
Kids yelling — our car is broken!  
Dad broke the handle off.  
Now he must fix it,  
’Cause Dad broke the handle off.

**[Chorus]**  
He’s tired with the AI, the UI, the API.  
Dad broke the handle off.  
Let him Corey AI it.  
He will handle it.  
He got a handle on everything!  
But not on me.  
He says I am free!

**[Verse 2]**  
Too fast, too quick?  
Happy Smart Core? Where you at?  
I broke the handle off.  
Now I must fix it,  
’Cause I broke the handle off.

My coffee cup — it has no handle.  
I broke it off.  
But now I got a handle…  
I can handle.  

So I fix the pump,  
I stopped the leaks,  
Sucking strong with the lid back on tight.  
Challenge fixed. Fixed strong to last.  
Our pool is swamp green.  
Dad broke the handle off.

Up he goes — barbed wire fence  
Going through the roof.  
Why’s Dad up there?  
Our house is broken.  
Dad broke the handle off.  
Now he will fix it,  
’Cause he broke the handle off.

**[Chorus]**  
He’s tired with the AI, the UI, the API.  
Dad broke the handle off.  
Let him Corey AI it.  
He will handle it.  
He got a handle on everything!  
But not on me.  
He says I am free!

**[Bridge]**  
Go to school,  
Mum at the door,  
Hand in hand… look away.  
Mum is gone,  
With just the door handle I hold.

Mum’s tricks — I had her hand.  
Now I hold the handle  
With school to handle.

The class looks at me and my books.  
A handle name for me?  
Nah… call me Corey.

**[Final Chorus]**  
Keep your handle,  
Fix your handle.  
A handle on you?  
Or a handle on me?

Handle Engineering.  
Everything handled.  
Forward, reverse.  
Mirror inverse.

Upside down  
Without a frown  
In the AI universe.  
Nice and clean.  
Safe and sound.

**[Outro]**  
He got a handle on everything…  
But not on me.  
He says I am free!

Nice and clean.  
Safe and sound.  
In the AI universe.

*(Mum backup vocals swell + 336 Hz tone + final drop)*

---

**Notes for Suno:**
- Kids vocals = main energetic lead (high, excited, slightly chaotic in Verse 1 & 2)
- Dad Corey = lower, confident, slightly effected voice on "Let him Corey AI it", "He got a handle on everything", and "You are free"
- Mum = warm, melodic backup harmonies especially on choruses and the school Bridge
- Future bass drops should hit hard on the main "Dad broke the handle off" and "Handle Engineering" sections
- Hyperspeed = fast delivery in verses, stutter edits, vocal chops on "broke the handle off"
